info.name: Gets a secret bundle by secret name and vault ID.

params.name: secretName
params.description: A user-friendly name for the secret. Secret names are unique within a vault. Secret names are case-sensitive.

params.name: vaultId
params.description: The OCID of the vault that contains the secret.

params.name: versionNumber
params.description: The version number of the secret.

params.name: secretVersionName
params.description: The name of the secret. (This might be referred to as the name of the secret version. Names are unique across the different versions of a secret.)

params.name: stage
params.description: The rotation state of the secret version.

items.docs:
Gets a secret bundle by secret name and vault ID, and secret version that matches either the specified `stage`, `secretVersionName`, or `versionNumber` parameter.
If none of these parameters are provided, the bundle for the secret version marked as `CURRENT` is returned.

params.name: versionNumber
params.description: The version number of the secret.

params.name: secretVersionName
params.description: The name of the secret. (This might be referred to as the name of the secret version. Names are unique across the different versions of a secret.)

params.name: stage
params.description: The rotation state of the secret version.

items.docs:
Gets a secret bundle that matches either the specified `stage`, `secretVersionName`, or `versionNumber` parameter.
If none of these parameters are provided, the bundle for the secret version marked as `CURRENT` will be returned.

params.name: limit
params.description:
The maximum number of items to return in a paginated "List" call. For information about pagination, see
[List Pagination](../../../#API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#List_Pagination).

params.name: page
params.description:
The value of the `opc-next-page` response header from the previous "List" call. For information about
pagination, see [List Pagination](../../../#API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#List_Pagination).

params.name: sortBy
params.description:
The field to sort by. You can specify only one sort order. The default
order for `VERSION_NUMBER` is descending.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either ascending (`ASC`) or descending (`DESC`).

items.docs: Lists all secret bundle versions for the specified secret.
